نبتده (form VIII)
# نَبْتَدِهُ (nabtadihu) /nab.ta.di.hu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# نُبْتَدَهُ (nubtadahu) /nub.ta.da.hu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# نَبْتَدِهَ (nabtadiha) /nab.ta.di.ha/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# نُبْتَدَهَ (nubtadaha) /nub.ta.da.ha/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
